reconfigure_auth.description: Pick how Home Assistant authenticates with this TV. For OAuth2, just select it and submit — the login flow starts automatically (the fields below are ignored). For PAT, paste a SmartThings Personal Access Token. For SmartThings Integration, pick an existing entry.

reconfigure_ip_control.title: IP Control
reconfigure_ip_control.description:
IP Control gives reliable power on/off (even from Art Mode) without SmartThings. Current status: {status}.

Check "Pair now" to (re)pair the TV — it must be ON in normal viewing with IP Remote enabled. The toggles below appear once paired.

data.ip_control_art_mode: Switch Art Mode over IP Control

reconfigure_ip_pair.title: Pair IP Control
reconfigure_ip_pair.description:
Pairs the TV's IP Control interface.

Before continuing:
1. The TV must be ON and in NORMAL viewing — not Art Mode.
2. Enable IP Remote: Settings → All Settings → Connections → Network → Expert Settings → Enable IP Remote.

Accept the authorization prompt on the TV when it appears. Current status: {status}.

reconfigure_st_device.title: SmartThings device
reconfigure_st_device.description:
Select which SmartThings device this TV corresponds to.

Currently: **{current}**

A TV that was repaired, reset, or removed and re-added in the SmartThings app gets a **new device id**, and the old one is refused with *Forbidden*. Re-selecting it here keeps your entities and history.

data_description.art_exit_source: Input or app to switch to when Art Mode is turned off from Home Assistant (Art Mode switch or art_set_artmode). Leave empty to keep the TV's own behaviour: it goes back to its last source, often TV (Samsung TV Plus) on a Frame. Not applied when Art Mode is left with the remote. Needs a source the TV can reach: a list auto-discovered from SmartThings holds ST_ keys, which fall back to the equivalent WebSocket key (ST_HDMI3 -> KEY_HDMI3) when SmartThings is unavailable. Some models ignore the numbered HDMI keys; the log says so when the TV did not move.
data_description.external_audio_entity: Optional: use an existing media player for actual volume and mute feedback while the TV uses external speakers. TV controls stay unchanged. Leave empty to use the TV readings. No additional polling is added. Select the actual soundbar or receiver, not a group or another entity that mirrors this TV.
data_description.rest_app_list: Map display names to native Tizen app IDs for apps missing from automatic discovery. Leave empty to disable additional REST status checks.
data_description.rest_app_poll_interval: Apps with a recent reading from the normal tracker need no extra checks. Other apps refresh every 30 seconds by default, with up to 120 scheduled checks per app per hour. Results are cached between refreshes; source changes and Art Mode events can refresh sooner. An empty app list adds no requests.
data_description.report_art_mode_as_off: Optional: report artwork as off while keeping art_mode_status on. Normal viewing remains on; physical power tracking and Art Mode controls continue. Disabled by default.
data_description.art_on_non_frame: Optional: enable Art Mode for a TV that reports itself as not a Frame but runs the art app, such as the 2026 Micro RGB R95H. The art-app channel is asked for its version and the Art Mode entities are created only when it answers. Have the TV on the first time. Disabled by default.
data_description.toggle_art_mode: Frame TVs only. When the media player's toggle action is used, switch between TV and Art Mode instead of powering off, like a short press of the Frame remote's power button: from Art Mode it goes back to the TV, while watching it goes to Art Mode, and from standby it turns the TV on. Turn on, turn off and the Power switch are not affected.

application_credentials.description:
To use OAuth2 authentication with Samsung TV Smart, you need to create SmartThings developer credentials.

**Setup Instructions:**

1. Go to [SmartThings Developer Portal]({smartthings_portal})
2. Sign in with your Samsung account
3. Click **New Project** → Select **Automation for the Home**
4. Give your project a name (e.g., 'Home Assistant TV')
5. Click **Register App** in the sidebar
6. Select **OAuth2 / Credentials**
7. Fill in the form:
   - **App Name**: Home Assistant Samsung TV
   - **Redirect URI**: `{callback_url}`
   - **Scopes**: Select `r:devices:*` and `x:devices:*`
8. Click **Save** and copy your credentials below

[SmartThings OAuth Documentation]({oauth_docs})

oauth2_implementation_unavailable.message: OAuth2 credentials are not configured. Please add SmartThings credentials in Settings → Devices & Services → Application Credentials.

oauth_auth_failed.title: SmartThings authentication failed for {device_name}
oauth_auth_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not refresh the SmartThings access token for **{device_name}**. The refresh token is no longer valid — this can happen when the token is revoked, expires, or is rotated by SmartThings.

SmartThings-based features (power state, picture mode, source selection) will not work until you reconnect.

To fix this, go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Samsung TV Smart**, select the affected entry, choose **Reconfigure**, and sign in with Samsung again.

legacy_art_camera.title: Camera on the old Frame Art picture of {device_name}
legacy_art_camera.description:
These cameras still point at the old location of the current artwork in `www`, which is no longer used: **{cameras}**.

Since 9.6.0 the Frame Art pictures are kept out of `www`, where Home Assistant served them to anyone without logging in. To keep a camera of the current artwork, either:

- use the **Current artwork** camera that {device_name} now provides, then delete the old camera; or
- for a Local File camera, change its file path to `{new_path}`.

A Generic Camera cannot simply be pointed elsewhere (the new address carries a token that changes at each restart): use the **Current artwork** camera instead.

This repair goes away once no camera points at the old location (checked when the integration starts).

show.name: Show Immediately
show.description: If true, immediately display the artwork

wake.name: Wake the TV
wake.description: If true (default), power the TV on and switch it to Art Mode first. If false, only change the artwork while Art Mode is already on screen, and do nothing otherwise — for slideshow loops that keep running while the TV is off.

art_upload.name: Upload Artwork
art_upload.description: Upload an image file to the Samsung Frame TV.

file_path.name: File Path
file_path.description: Path to the image file to upload

matte_id.description: Matte style, "type_color" (e.g. modern_apricot, shadowbox_polar). Both halves must exist on YOUR TV — call art_get_matte_list to see its lists, or read the options of the Matte Type / Matte Color selects. An id the TV does not know is refused before the upload. Use "none" for no matte.

show.name: Show Immediately
show.description: Display the artwork on the TV as soon as it is uploaded.

art_upload_batch.name: Batch Upload Artwork
art_upload_batch.description: Upload every image (jpg/png) in a folder to the Frame TV. Re-running the same folder uploads only new/changed files (a hidden per-folder sidecar tracks what was uploaded), and uploads are throttled so large batches don't fail partway through. Returns the uploaded content_ids (use a response variable).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Absolute path to the folder of images to upload.

matte_id.name: Matte Style
matte_id.description: Matte style (format: type_color, e.g., modern_apricot, shadowbox_polar).

throttle.name: Throttle (seconds)
throttle.description: Delay between uploads. Large batches fail without spacing.

skip_unchanged.name: Skip unchanged files
skip_unchanged.description: Skip files already uploaded and unchanged since the last run.

dedup.name: Skip perceptual duplicates
dedup.description: Also skip a file that visually matches art already on the TV (compared against the downloaded thumbnails). Strict match to avoid false skips. Requires thumbnails to have been downloaded first.

art_delete.name: Delete Artwork
art_delete.description: Delete an uploaded artwork from the TV. Only user-uploaded content (MY-* or MY_*) can be deleted.

content_id.name: Content ID
content_id.description: The content ID to delete (must start with MY- or MY_)

art_get_thumbnail.name: Get Artwork Thumbnail
art_get_thumbnail.description: Download the thumbnail image for a specific piece of artwork. Thumbnails are saved to /config/.storage/samsungtv_smart/frame_art/ in organized subdirectories (personal/, store/, other/). Skips if file already exists unless Force Download is enabled. Works with all image types including Samsung Art Store.

content_id.name: Content ID
content_id.description: The content ID of the artwork (e.g., MY_F0001 for personal photos, SAM-S* for Art Store)

force_download.name: Force Download
force_download.description: Re-download even if file already exists

art_get_thumbnails_batch.name: Batch Download Artwork Thumbnails
art_get_thumbnails_batch.description: Download thumbnails for multiple artworks at once. Automatically organizes into /config/.storage/samsungtv_smart/frame_art/personal/, /store/, /other/. Skips files that already exist (unless Force Download is enabled). All image types supported equally - NO DRM assumptions! Perfect for Lovelace galleries.

category_id.name: Category ID
category_id.description: Optional category filter (MY-C0002=My Photos, MY-C0004=Favorites, MY-C0008=All). Leave empty for all artworks.

favorites_only.name: Favorites Only
favorites_only.description: Enable to download ONLY favorited artworks (leave OFF for all artworks)

personal_only.name: Personal Photos Only
personal_only.description: Enable to download ONLY your uploaded photos (leave OFF for all artworks)

force_download.name: Force Download
force_download.description: Re-download files even if they already exist (normally skipped to save time)

art_get_device_info.name: Get Art Device Info

art_set_picture_mode.name: Set Art Picture Mode
art_set_picture_mode.description: Set the Art Mode picture type (the art app's art_picture_mode). The value is the TV platform's own number: read the current one with art_get_device_info, or from the Frame Art sensor's art_picture_mode attribute, before changing it.

art_picture_mode.name: Art picture mode
art_picture_mode.description: Picture type value as reported by the TV

art_restart_app.name: Restart the Art Mode app
art_restart_app.description: Stop and relaunch the TV's built-in Art Mode app (org.tizen.art-app). Last resort for a Frame whose art app has stopped answering — the one whose Art Mode no longer toggles from Home Assistant nor from the TV's own remote. It is the software equivalent of a power cycle, without cutting the power. EXPERIMENTAL: the art app is a built-in Tizen app and some models decline to stop one, in which case the TV accepts the command and nothing changes. The panel may go dark while the app is down. The response reports the stop and the start separately.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait between stopping the app and launching it again. Raise it if the app comes back in the same wedged state.

art_recover.name: Recover the Art Mode channel
art_recover.description: Press KEY_POWER once to revive a Frame whose Art Mode channel has wedged — the socket connects but ms.channel.ready never arrives and every art request times out. On some 2020 Frames this is the only thing that brings the art app back (art_restart_app does nothing there). Meant for TVs with no IP Control paired, driven from your own automation. WARNING: KEY_POWER TOGGLES Art Mode on a Frame — pressing it while the TV is already in Art Mode turns the panel off. The service therefore refuses when Art Mode is already on, and when the TV is off; it acts only on a powered TV that is not currently in Art Mode. It presses once, waits, and reports whether Art Mode came back.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait after the key press before reading back whether Art Mode recovered.

wake.name: Wake the TV

art_set_auto_rotation.description: Configure automatic artwork rotation. Functionally identical to art_set_slideshow — both service names are aliases that target the Frame TV's artwork rotation feature; the integration routes the request to whichever underlying Samsung API the TV responds to.

duration.description: Rotation interval. Pick a preset or enter a custom value (e.g. "30", "30min", "180") if your Frame model supports durations outside the presets.
